name: detectai-workers (loadtest)
description: Load-test view for all workers (deployment.environment = loadtest): k6-driven queue traffic per rig (analytics.k6.js / cron.k6.js / payments.k6.js) plus collector infra. Rigs run one worker at a time via make load-test WORKER=<name> WITH_OBSERVABILITY=1. Kept page-for-page in sync with workers.json (only the deployment.environment filter differs).

pages.name: Overview
pages.description: Cross-worker health: throughput, errors, latency, broker connectivity, DLQ

rawConfiguration.text:
## Workers overview (`loadtest`)
Three independent deployables: `worker-analytics` (queue `analytics.usage`, dedup prefix `analytics:usage:event:`), `worker-payments` (queue `payment_events`, Paddle idempotency), `worker-cron` (sweeps expired/paused subscriptions every `CRON_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, default 900000).
**Start here.** If a gauge below is red, jump to that worker's page for the breakdown. Watches: broker/Redis disconnected, DLQ growth, expiry lag, eventloop lag.
**Sampling.** Analytics and payments trace at `traceidratio 0.1`, so span *rates* are indicative; counts and rates on this page come from Prometheus metrics (exact). Cron traces at `always_on`.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT sum(rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute)) AS `msgs/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service IN ('worker-analytics', 'worker-payments')
FROM Metric SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE worker_job_errors_total > 0) AS `error %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service IN ('worker-analytics', 'worker-payments')
FROM Metric SELECT sum(worker_dead_lettered_total) AS `dead letters` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest'
FROM Metric SELECT sum(rate(sum(worker_retry_total), 1 minute)) AS `retries/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest'
FROM Metric SELECT min(latest(rabbitmq_connection_status)) AS `connected` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service IN ('worker-analytics', 'worker-payments')
FROM Metric SELECT latest(worker_cron_expiry_lag_seconds) AS `lag s` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(worker_cron_expired_backlog) AS `backlog` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron'
FROM Metric SELECT max(average(process_runtime_nodejs_eventloop_lag_ms)) AS `loop lag ms` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest'
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_job_errors_total), 1 minute) AS `errors/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name LIKE 'worker-%' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_retry_total), 1 minute) AS `retries/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_dead_lettered_total), 1 minute) AS `dead/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5
FROM Metric SELECT average(rabbitmq_connection_status) AS `rabbitmq` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(redis_connection_status) AS `redis` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_duplicate_events_total), 1 minute) AS `duplicates/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_job_errors_total), 1 minute) AS `errors/min`, sum(worker_job_errors_total) AS `total` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service, job_type, error_type LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Messages processed by worker and type (load)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min`, sum(worker_jobs_processed_total) AS `total`, average(worker_message_size_bytes) AS `avg bytes` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service, job_type LIMIT 25

pages.name: Analytics
pages.description: worker-analytics: consumes analytics.usage, dedupes, writes Usage

rawConfiguration.text:
## Worker analytics (`worker-analytics`, `loadtest`)
Queue `analytics.usage`. Dedup prefix `analytics:usage:event:` in redis-users, then UPSERT into `Usage`. Traces sample at `traceidratio 0.1`, so counts below come from Prometheus metrics, not spans.
**Watches:** consumer stalled (no throughput), `worker_duplicate_events_total` climbing (redelivery or replay), DB write errors, eventloop lag.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics'
FROM Metric SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE worker_job_errors_total > 0) AS `error %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest'
FROM Metric SELECT sum(worker_dead_lettered_total) AS `dead letters` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics'
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_duplicate_events_total), 1 minute) AS `duplicates/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'worker-analytics' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_job_errors_total), 1 minute) AS `errors/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' FACET error_type TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 8
FROM Metric SELECT average(worker_active_jobs) AS `active jobs` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT average(worker_active_instances) AS `instances` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE cache_operations_total > 0 AND operation = 'hit') AS `hit %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(redis_connection_status) AS `redis` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT average(rabbitmq_connection_status) AS `rabbitmq` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT sum(worker_job_errors_total) AS `errors`, max(worker_job_errors_total) AS `latest` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-analytics' FACET job_type, error_type LIMIT 25

pages.name: Cron
pages.description: worker-cron: sweeps expired and paused subscriptions on a fixed interval

rawConfiguration.text:
## Worker cron (`worker-cron`, `loadtest`)
Sweeps every `CRON_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS` (default 900000 = 15 min) in batches of `CRON_BATCH_SIZE` (default 100). Traces sample at `always_on`, so span counts here are exact.
**A missed tick is the failure that matters:** `worker_cron_expiry_lag_seconds` measures how long the oldest expired subscription has waited. It should stay near one sweep interval; above 2x the interval the sweeper is stalled. `worker_cron_db_lock_skipped_total` rising means concurrent sweeps are contending on `SKIP LOCKED` rows.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_cron_loop_iterations_total), 1 minute) AS `ticks/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(worker_cron_expiry_lag_seconds) AS `lag s` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(worker_cron_expired_backlog) AS `backlog` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron'
FROM Metric SELECT sum(worker_cron_stale_events_filtered_total) AS `stale events` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT average(worker_cron_sweep_batch_size) AS `batch size` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_cron_loop_iterations_total), 1 minute) AS `iterations/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron' FACET result TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(worker_cron_subscription_status) AS `subscriptions` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron' FACET status TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 8

widgets.title: DB lock skips and shutdown aborts (load)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_cron_db_lock_skipped_total), 1 minute) AS `lock skips/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_cron_shutdown_aborts_total), 1 minute) AS `shutdown aborts/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95) WHERE service.name = 'worker-cron' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND name LIKE '%cache%' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT sum(worker_cron_loop_iterations_total) AS `iterations`, max(worker_cron_loop_iterations_total) AS `latest` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron' FACET result LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT latest(worker_cron_config) AS `config` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-cron' FACET key LIMIT 10

pages.name: Payments
pages.description: worker-payments: consumes payment_events, Paddle idempotency and retries

rawConfiguration.text:
## Worker payments (`worker-payments`, `loadtest`)
Consumes queue `payment_events` from the Paddle webhook gateway. Dedupes on event id (redis-events), then drives the subscription state machine. Paddle API calls are outbound from here, so `paddle_request_duration_seconds` spikes show up as slow jobs.
Traces sample at `traceidratio 0.1`. **Watches:** `worker_dead_lettered_total` rising (usually `UserNotFoundError` or an invalid state transition), `worker_infra_requeued_total` climbing (DB down, so failures requeue instead of dead-lettering), Paddle call latency.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments'
FROM Metric SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE worker_job_errors_total > 0) AS `error %` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments'
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS `p95 ms` WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest'
FROM Metric SELECT sum(worker_dead_lettered_total) AS `dead letters` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments'
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_infra_requeued_total), 1 minute) AS `requeues/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = 'loadtest' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_job_errors_total), 1 minute) AS `errors/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments' FACET error_type TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 8
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `events/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments' FACET job_type TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT average(paddle_request_duration_seconds) * 1000 AS `paddle avg ms` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_duplicate_events_total), 1 minute) AS `duplicates/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_idempotency_redis_errors_total), 1 minute) AS `redis errors/min` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service = 'worker-payments' TIMESERIES AUTO

pages.name: Infra
pages.description: Node runtime, containers and dependency pool pressure across all workers

rawConfiguration.text:
## Workers infra (`loadtest`)
Node eventloop lag is the leading indicator for a stalled consumer: a worker blocked on a sync DB call or a slow Paddle response shows up as lag long before throughput visibly drops. `db_pool_connections` in the `waiting` state means the pool is exhausted and jobs are queueing for a connection.
Container names are `worker_analytics`, `worker_cron`, `worker_payments` in the prod stack (underscores), and `workers-load-<worker>-worker-<worker>-1` under the load rigs (hyphens), which is why these widgets filter on `worker%` rather than an exact name.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(process_runtime_nodejs_eventloop_lag_ms) AS `loop lag ms` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(process_heap_used_bytes) / 1000000 AS `heap MB` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(db_pool_connections) AS `connections` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service, state TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Metric SELECT average(worker_message_size_bytes) AS `avg bytes` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes`), 1 minute) AS rx WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes`), 1 minute) AS tx WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(`container.cpu.throttling_data.throttled_time`), 1 minute) AS `throttled ns/s` WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Span SELECT count(*) AS spans WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service.name LIKE 'worker-%' FACET service.name, service.version LIMIT 20
FROM Metric SELECT count(*) AS metric_series WHERE deployment.environment = 'loadtest' AND service LIKE 'worker%' FACET service LIMIT 10
